description: Each tool call gets only the access its task needs, for as short a time as possible.
OWASP LLM06 in the 2025 edition (renumbered in later editions): an agent with more tools, permissions or autonomy than the feature needs, so a manipulated model can do real damage.
A component with more rights than its requester is tricked into using them for the requester. Agents with broad keys are the classic case.
The harness component that issues a fresh, scoped, short-lived credential per tool call and revokes it afterwards.
OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange (RFC 8693): trading one token for a narrower one for a specific downstream service.
`{{secret:NAME}}`: what the model writes instead of a credential; the harness resolves it at the tool boundary for granted secrets only.
Replacing known secrets (raw, base64, URL-encoded) in tool output and logs before they reach the model or storage. The last net, not the main control.
